meta.name: mem-search
meta.description: Search claude-mem's persistent cross-session memory database. Use when user asks "did we already solve this?", "how did we do X last time?", or needs work from previous sessions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索跨会话记忆数据库，快速找回历史工作
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要从之前的对话中找回解决方案或上下文
copy.tagline_en: Search cross-session memory database to quickly retrieve past work
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to recall solutions or context from previous conversations

howto.what: 它会先搜索你过去所有会话的记录，返回带编号的索引表；然后展示你选中条目周围的时间线上下文；最后只获取你选定记录的完整内容。
howto.when: 当用户询问之前会话的内容，例如“我们以前解决过这个问题吗？”、“上次是怎么做 X 的？”、“上周发生了什么？”等，就会触发搜索。

say.text: 我们上次是怎么修复登录问题的？
say.note: 会立刻搜索过去的会话记录

say.text: 查一下上周关于认证的改动，总结一下。
say.note: 先搜索再筛选并获取完整记录

say.text: 找到那次修复 JWT 的笔记，把细节展开。
say.note: 会定位到相关 ID 并返回完整详情

howto.what_en: It starts by searching your past session records and returns an indexed list with IDs; then, for an item you pick, it shows the surrounding timeline context; finally it fetches only the full details of the selected records.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks about previous sessions (not the current conversation), e.g., 'Did we already fix this?', 'How did we solve X last time?', 'What happened last week?'.

say_en.text: How did we fix the login issue last time?
Look up last week's auth changes and summarize.
say_en.note: Searches, filters and fetches full records.

say_en.text: Find the note about the JWT fix and show details.
say_en.note: Locates the ID and returns full details.
